proposals.downside_risk: This will likely demote some previously favored patterns and reduce apparent opportunity count until stronger multi-wallet cohorts are found.

evidence.detail: avg_net_base is calculated from positive proven trades only, so losing proven trades do not reduce the stored pattern average.
profitable-wallet pattern research exports and ranks learned patterns using avg_net_base, confidence and replicability.
the lab objective explicitly prioritises money-weighted net P&L, profit factor and largest loss over raw win count.

proposals.expected_effect: Ranking patterns with all proven net outcomes, plus explicit gross-positive/gross-negative context, should reduce false-positive shadow candidates and better align learned-route replication with money-weighted net profitability.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 20 proven pattern observations and 2 non-overlapping time windows per chain type.
proposals.rationale: A positive-only average can make a route family look attractive even when a few larger losses erase the gains in aggregate. That conflicts with the repository objective of durable net P&L after costs and can bias learned-pattern research toward high-win-rate but fragile routes.
proposals.shadow_test: Recompute pattern summaries with all proven net_base rows (not just winners), then compare the next shadow cohort against the current ranking on out-of-sample net P&L after recorded costs, profit factor and largest loss separately for Solana and EVM. Reject the change if the revised ranking lowers opportunity count without improving post-cost net results or tail-loss control.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote/simulation data can be over-trusted if documentation and tests do not keep the hard boundary that simulated edge is not realised P&L or promotion evidence.

evidence.detail: the Solana adapter explicitly states that current gross edge, liquidity and sellability remain fail-closed at zero because no contemporaneous executable quote is available.
Solana shadow events are marked current_edge_proven=false and needs_quote_feature_adapter=true.
the scorecard already reports a solana_current_quote_edge_adapter evidence gap when those events are seen.

proposals.expected_effect: Adding a bounded Solana quote/liquidity/sellability adapter should convert more Solana observations from signal-only placeholders into comparable shadow evidence without changing any live execution path.
proposals.minimum_observation: 24 shadow hours and at least 30 recent Solana observations with chain-specific fee/priority-cost fields populated.
proposals.rationale: The repository requires chain-specific executability, liquidity, sellability and cost models. Today the Solana lane can show scanning activity, but it cannot yet produce comparable current executable-edge evidence to the EVM lane, so cross-chain shadow conclusions are structurally incomplete.
proposals.shadow_test: Add a Solana quote feature adapter that records current executable quotes, liquidity and sellability while keeping promotion_evidence=false and live submission disabled. Success requires increased Solana executable_quote_simulations coverage and better chain-by-chain evidence completeness without any live order path or any claim of realised profitability.

proposals.downside_risk: A stricter evaluator may delay promotion of legitimately good but fee-heavy strategies until thresholds are recalibrated on enough shadow data.

evidence.detail: strategy metrics track fees, slippage_cost and net_profit, but profit_factor is still computed from gross_profit divided by gross_loss.
promotion/replacement decisions rely on net_profit plus a profit-factor threshold that is not directly cost-adjusted.
the positive-candidate test confirms the current promotion path uses the existing evaluator thresholds.

proposals.expected_effect: Using a cost-adjusted companion ratio or stronger post-cost gating should reduce the chance of promoting thin-edge strategies whose gross profit factor masks recurring execution leakage.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 3 windows and 8 trades per strategy per chain, plus one later out-of-sample replay window.
proposals.rationale: A strategy can look cleaner on gross win/loss ratio than it really is once recurring fees and slippage are considered. Because the Strategy Lab objective is durable net profitability after recorded costs, the evaluator should rank cost-fragile strategies more conservatively.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay existing strategy_lab_windows with both the current evaluator and a cost-adjusted variant, then compare promoted candidates on subsequent out-of-sample net P&L after costs, profit factor and largest loss by chain. Reject the change if it suppresses clearly positive, adequately sampled strategies without improving post-cost drawdown control.

rejected_ideas.reason: Repository guidance and Strategy Lab research code explicitly prefer repeated behaviours across multiple profitable wallets and learned patterns over reliance on one selected wallet.

summary: Static review of source commit 40e838ee6479f3eb0d844176a379ea85f9299200 found three bounded Strategy Lab improvements worth shadow-only follow-up: learned-pattern ranking currently overweights winners by averaging only positive proven trades, the Solana shadow lane still lacks current executable quote/liquidity evidence, and portfolio promotion logic still relies on a gross-loss profit-factor ratio even though fees and slippage are tracked separately. Fresh runtime evidence is not available, so this report does not claim profitability, canary readiness, or live readiness.
